source_classes.funding: actually settled contract rates; converted to a common 8h settlement basis
source_classes.liquidations: reported USD forced liquidations from Binance and Bybit only
source_classes.liquidations_30d_vendor: 30 days of observed Binance+Bybit liquidation vendor quantity, not mixed with Edge
source_classes.cme_cot: weekly BTC CME standard futures only, positions in 5 BTC contracts
source_classes.dated_futures_basis: expiry-aware non-CME futures/spot basis, not funding
source_classes.cme_basis: historical verified CME dated futures premium against matched spot from Boros, not proxy

24h.source: Edge or Not; Binance+Bybit reported forced liquidations
24h.units: USD; observed venue records; not all global exchange liquidations

168h.source: Edge or Not; Binance+Bybit reported forced liquidations
168h.units: USD; observed venue records; not all global exchange liquidations

liquidations_30d_vendor.source: Sharpe Terminal futures/liquidations, underlying provider velo
liquidations_30d_vendor.unit_warning: Vendor 'quantity' scales approximately as USD liquidation notional; not a separately audited USD guarantee. Do not add to Edge observed USD without a method match.

cme_cot.source: CFTC TFF futures-only BTC CME contract 133741 (5 BTC per contract)
cme_cot.unit: CME standard BTC futures CONTRACTS, multiplied by 5 for equivalent BTC

cme_basis.reason: Verified CME matched-settlement futures-vs-spot annualized basis not yet available

cme_basis.source: Boros Historical Data / futures-premium CME directly identified contracts
cme_basis.warning: CME holidays/weekends produce multi-day gaps; near-expiry <7d excluded; not a continuous roll-adjusted series

limitations: CME basis from independently labelled Boros CME price history, NOT CFTC. When source stale or a contract is close to expiration mark unavailable.
Binance/Bybit direct REST API were blocked from GitHub; Sharpe verified exchange data is used instead.
Liquidations from only two exchanges are NOT world totals. Binance sampling may undercount forced orders.
Sharpe 30d liquidation quantity has no explicit USD unit in this endpoint; do not blindly sum with Edge USD numbers.
OI changes compare same five venues, fixed USD definitions; raw linear BTC OI must not be summed with coin-margined contract counts.
Funding settlement rates are periodic fractions, not APR; compare aligned 8h normalizations.
Futures contract rolls break a continuous dated basis curve unless expiry is retained.
CFTC COT weekly reporting lags and is a different scope from perpetual OI.
